items.name: styles
items.description: Plex UI design tokens and component styles (import once before mounting the app).

items.name: accordion
items.description: Vertically stacked panels that expand to reveal content, with one or several items open at a time and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: alert
items.description: Inline message for notices and warnings with semantic colors, variants, a title, a description, action slots, and a dismiss control.

items.name: avatar
items.description: An avatar for user identities that shows an initial, a photo or an icon, with overflow counts, semantic colors and roundness options.

items.name: avatar-group
items.description: Stacks user avatars into a single overlapping cluster, with a configurable stacking direction and one size for the whole group.

items.name: badge
items.description: Compact label for statuses and inline metadata, with semantic colors, three variants and sizes, icon support, and a loading state.

items.name: button
items.description: Button with four variants (solid, soft, outline, ghost), eight semantic colors, icon slots, loading, and block layout.

items.name: button-group
items.description: Join buttons into a single visual unit for toolbars, steppers, split buttons and search affordances.

items.name: button-link
items.description: A semantic anchor with full button styling, for internal and external links with icons and block layout.

items.name: card
items.description: Card surface for composing login flows, sign-up forms, pricing tiles, payment methods, empty states, and stat showcases.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Checkbox for binary on/off selection with solid, pill, and ghost variants, an indeterminate state, and rich labels with inline descriptions.

items.name: code-block
items.description: Code block with syntax highlighting, a copy button, and collapsible long snippets with configurable expanded height limits.

items.name: copy-tooltip
items.description: A copy-to-clipboard tooltip that wraps any trigger element and confirms when the value has been copied.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Modal dialog for confirmations, forms, and destructive alerts, with a focus trap, escape handling, and an overlay scrim.

items.name: empty-message
items.description: Empty state for telling users there's nothing to show, with error, warning, no-results, and onboarding compositions.

items.name: file-upload
items.description: Mobile-first file upload with MIME-type and size validation, multi-file selection, error states, and read-only file cards.

items.name: floating-label-input
items.description: Text input whose label floats above the value, with error and helper text, a clear button, a password reveal toggle, and a multi-line variant.

items.name: indicators
items.description: Loading and progress indicators, from circular spinners and determinate progress rings to animated dots, with configurable color and stroke.

items.name: input
items.description: Text input with start and end adornments, a clear button, a password visibility toggle, and presets for SSN and birthday.

items.name: label
items.description: Accessible form label that points at any control by its id, so clicking it focuses or toggles the control, with consistent typography across forms.

items.name: markdown
items.description: Markdown renderer for rich formatted content, with headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and KaTeX math expressions out of the box.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.description: Compact rich text editor powered by Tiptap, embedded in a form field, with a markdown formatting toolbar, variants, and an invalid state.

items.name: menu
items.description: Dropdown menu for structured actions with grouped items, submenus, checkbox and radio items, and horizontal layouts.

items.name: otp-input
items.description: Input for one-time passwords and verification codes, with split digit cells, grouped layouts, error states, and autofill.

items.name: popover
items.description: A floating panel for contextual UI, with flexible sizing, hover triggers, a controllable open state and nesting.

items.name: progress
items.description: A horizontal bar that shows task completion, with determinate and indeterminate modes, labelled layouts, and smooth value transitions.

items.name: progress-steps
items.description: Stepper for multi-step flows like checkouts and onboarding, with horizontal or vertical layout, icons, navigation, and color tokens.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: Radio group for single-choice selection with row or column layout, right-aligned indicators, rich item content, and card-style options.

items.name: separator
items.description: A thin divider between content, horizontal or vertical, decorative by default or exposed to assistive technology when it marks a real grouping.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.description: Text with a shimmer animation for loading and in-progress states, always on or toggled with a graceful stop.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: Composable navigation sidebar for app shells with collapsible sections, search and filter, tree views with hover actions, and a mobile menu

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders that match the shape of the content they stand in for, from avatars and text to cards, forms, and tables.

items.name: slider
items.description: Slider for fine-tuning numeric values with single or range thumbs, marks, an editable value input, and vertical orientation.

items.name: stat-card
items.description: Stat card for dashboards displaying KPIs with trend deltas, an info tooltip, an icon, a progress bar, and accent border styling.

items.name: switch
items.description: Toggle switch for turning settings on or off, with an optional label, a supporting description linked for screen readers, and a configurable label position.

items.name: table
items.description: Styled table primitives for structured data, with header, body, footer, row, cell and caption parts on native table elements.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Switch between grouped views with segmented or underline tabs, icon-only triggers, and badge counts on each tab.

items.name: tag-input
items.description: Input for entering multiple unique values as chip-style tokens, with suggestions and keyboard editing.

items.name: text-link
items.description: Text link for inline internal and external links with router integration, color inheritance, underline control, and weight options.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input that can grow with its content, with a size scale, autofill extension control, and invalid state styling.

items.name: toast
items.description: Toast notifications for transient feedback, with semantic variants, descriptions, action buttons, promise integration, and persistent toasts.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Brief informative text shown on hover or focus, for any trigger element, with conditional enabling and a compact variant.
